description: This file defines the functionality for deleting an article, including a command record, a validator, and a query handler that interacts with the database context to remove an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article by its slug, performing database lookup and removal.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the specified article from the database, throwing a RestException if not found.
